# GSAP distribution

Self-hosted GSAP 3.15.1 and ScrollTrigger, copied without modification from the pinned npm package.
Original copyright and license notices are retained in both files.

- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.1
- Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- Refresh: `npm ci && npm run motion:vendor`
- Verify: `node scripts/sync-motion-vendor.mjs --verify` (included in `npm run check`)

Source maps are not deployed; the readable upstream sources are available in the pinned npm package.
